definitions.explanation: To break up and move earth with a tool or hands.
To dig out or uncover something buried in the ground.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{井戸|いど}を{掘|ほ}った。
examples.english: We dug a well in the garden.

examples.japanese: {遺跡|いせき}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす。

notes:
{掘|ほ}る means to dig into the ground or excavate.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: {穴|あな}を{掘|ほ}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {穴|あな}を{掘|ほ}る: to dig a hole
- {井戸|いど}を{掘|ほ}る: to dig a well
- {掘|ほ}り{出|だ}す: to dig up, to unearth
- {掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす: to excavate
- {掘|ほ}り{下|さ}げる: to dig deeper

HOMOPHONE:
- {彫|ほ}る (to carve) has the same reading but different meaning.
- {掘|ほ}る: to dig OUT from the ground
- {彫|ほ}る: to carve INTO a surface
